audit.title: Audit log
auth.dialog.intro: Sign-in is optional — Lumen works fully without an account. Sign in to unlock persistent collab rooms, cloud sync, and semantic search.
auth.error.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect. Check them or reset your password.
auth.error.network: Can't reach the sign-in service. Check your connection, VPN or proxy and try again — Lumen keeps working locally meanwhile.
auth.error.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again — your local documents are untouched.
auth.error.ssoDenied: Your identity provider refused the sign-in. Ask your IT admin to give you access to Lumen.
auth.error.ssoNoConnection: No SSO organization is set up for that domain. Check the spelling or ask your admin to add it.
auth.error.ssoStateMismatch: The sign-in link expired or was opened in another browser. Start the SSO sign-in again.
auth.error.unknown: Something went wrong while signing in. Try again; if it keeps happening, see the troubleshooting guide.
auth.status.notConfigured.hint: This build runs in local-only mode — everything works offline. To enable accounts, set the auth environment variables and rebuild.
auth.status.signedOut.hint: Sign in to unlock cloud sync, persistent rooms and Smart search. Your local files keep working.
billing.action.signInFirst: Sign in first to choose a plan.
billing.aiQuota.exceeded: You've used all {limit} AI prompts for this month. Upgrade for more.
billing.upgrade.auditLog: The audit log is available on the Team plan.
